19,899 fans rated Slayyyter's WOR$T GIRL IN AMERICA on albumoftheyear.org (score 83, as of Oct 15, 2026), more than all but two albums in 2026's top 100. Its companion, Wor$t Man in America, is out Dec 4. 💿

The nine-track follow-up (RECORDS/Columbia, per Stereogum and Clash) includes "brand new chanel$", "crank 2" and "i think he's got a girl". "brand new chanel$" gave her a Billboard Hot 100 debut at #98 (via BroadwayWorld) and is her fastest song on Spotify at 530.9K streams a day.

Slayyyter has 9.9M Spotify monthly listeners, up from 854.3K in a Mar 2, 2021 Wayback snapshot (11.6x), with 837.5M lifetime streams across 90 tracks. Biggest songs: "DANCE..." 91.2M, "Mine" 74.0M, "CRANK" 51.5M, "BEAT UP CHANEL$" 47.3M (kworb, Oct 15, 2026).

Will the sequel beat the 83? 👇

Data: albumoftheyear.org, Spotify monthly listeners, Wayback Machine, kworb · as of Oct 15, 2026
